summary.intent: Fix a secret leak in the callisto redactor by adding shape-based secret redaction and redaction of values from secret-named env vars, then verify against a real-binary leak fixture and open a PR.
summary.outcome: Redaction was extended with unit tests, the real-binary leak fixture was re-run on the fixed build, REL-PUB-11 in the release spec was updated, a changeset was added, CI was run, and a redaction PR was committed and opened.

repo: Work was done in a separate git worktree for the 'safety stack' rather than the main checkout.
Redaction behavior is documented in specs and docs; docs/specs/release.json holds requirement entries such as REL-PUB-11 that must be updated when redaction behavior changes.
Changes require a changeset and a CI run before the PR is opened.
The redactor has dedicated unit tests, and a real-binary leak fixture is used as an end-to-end check beyond them.

code.finding: Modified as part of the redaction change (shape-based secret redaction and secret-named env value redaction). The transcript gives no line numbers, so none are recorded.
REL-PUB-11 was updated to match the new redaction behavior. The transcript gives no line numbers, so none are recorded.

workflow: Check regex crate availability before adding pattern-based redaction.
Re-run the real-binary leak fixture after the fix to confirm the leak is actually closed, not just unit-tested.
Grep specs and docs for existing redaction statements so they stay consistent with the code change.
